forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Break cycles by moving the shared rule to src/domain/ or src/lib/, or keep the dependency in one direction.

forbidden.name: domain-pure-core
forbidden.comment: Put Node I/O in src/server/; keep src/domain/ functions pure.

forbidden.name: domain-pure-path
forbidden.comment: Put React UI in src/components/ and Next or I/O code in src/server/; keep src/domain/ functions pure.

forbidden.name: server-public-api
forbidden.comment: Import server code through src/server.ts; files in src/server/ are its internals.

forbidden.name: index-client-safe
forbidden.comment: Keep src/index.ts client-safe: it may not reach src/server.ts or src/server/, also through another file; expose server code through src/server.ts.

forbidden.name: not-to-test
forbidden.comment: Keep test fixtures and assertions in colocated *.test.ts(x) files; move reusable production logic to src/domain/ or src/lib/.
